remarks: Welcome to 29 Priscilla Road in Norwalk, CT, a stunning and spacious Hi-Ranch style home nestled on a quiet residential street in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. This beautifully maintained property offers over 3,100 sq. ft. of living space, featuring 7 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, thoughtfully designed to deliver both comfort and style. Step inside to a bright, open-concept main level filled with natural light. The expansive living room, complete with a charming fireplace, flows seamlessly into the formal dining area and the well-appointed kitchen. Here you'll find granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry, an ideal setup for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite includes a private full bath, while the additional bedrooms are generously sized with excellent closet space. The finished lower level adds incredible versatility, offering a large family room with a second fireplace, a full bathroom, and walk-out access to the backyard. This space is perfect for an in-law suite, home office, recreation area, or guest accommodations. Step outside to your own private outdoor retreat. The spacious back deck is perfect for dining al fresco, hosting gatherings, or unwinding while overlooking the lush, landscaped yard and mature trees. Additional features include an attached two-car garage, central air, hardwood floors, and abundant storage throughout. Conveniently located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and Route 7
